title: Understanding Mean-Centering
text: Mean-centering involves subtracting the mean of each column from the respective column values, except for the intercept column. This ensures that the mean of each column is zero.

title: Effect of Mean-Centering on Intercept
text: When you mean-center the data, the intercept term in the linear regression model becomes zero. This is because the mean of the response variable is subtracted from each observation, effectively centering the data around zero.

title: Full Column Rank
text: A matrix has full column rank if all its columns are linearly independent. This means there are no redundant columns, and the matrix can be inverted if it is square.
